shift.title: Shifts
shift.subtitle: Start/end times, breaks, grace periods, punch windows and standard hours
shift.endTimeHint: An end time at or before the start time means the shift ends the next day.
shift.stdHoursHint: Leave empty to use the shift's working time (span minus unpaid breaks).
shift.dayValueHint: Working-day value of the shift, e.g. 0.5 for a half-day shift.
shift.breaksHint: A fixed break has a start and end; a flexible break only a duration.
shift.nightHint: Leave empty to use the statutory night window (legal parameter).

field.minMinutesHalfDay: Minimum minutes for a half day
field.minMinutesFullDay: Minimum minutes for a full day

pattern.title: Schedule patterns
pattern.subtitle: Weekly schedules (5, 5.5 or 6-day weeks; alternating weeks) and weekly rest days
pattern.frozenHint: Once a pattern is assigned, its cycle, anchor and days are frozen: create a new pattern and reassign.
pattern.cycleHint: 14 days for alternating weeks (e.g. every other Saturday).
pattern.anchorHint: Day 0 of the cycle; must be a Monday.
pattern.anchorMonday: The anchor date must be a Monday
pattern.daysHint: Work: with a shift. Weekly rest: the statutory rest day, the same in every week. Off: not worked but not a rest day (e.g. the free Saturday of an alternating week).

rule.title: Schedule rules
rule.subtitle: Assign patterns automatically by legal entity, org unit, location, job title, employee category and working regime
rule.regenerateHint: Re-evaluates the rules for every assignment line of the selected legal entity (empty: all). Manual schedules are kept.
rule.regenerated: {count, plural, =0 {No schedule changed} one {# assignment line changed} other {# assignment lines changed}}
rule.saved: {count, plural, =0 {Saved; no schedule changed} one {Saved; # assignment line changed} other {Saved; # assignment lines changed}}
rule.criteriaHint: Empty criteria match everyone. The first matching rule (by priority) applies.
rule.orgUnitHint: Matches this exact unit only (not its sub-units yet).
rule.orgUnitNeedsLegalEntity: A rule on an org unit also names the unit's legal entity
rule.regimeHint: Working regime code of the assignment, e.g. FULL_TIME.

assignment.title: Employee schedules
assignment.subtitle: Rule-based and manual schedules, planned days and standard days
assignment.regenerateConfirm: Re-evaluate the rules for every assignment line of this employee?
assignment.manualHint: A manual schedule replaces the rule-based one for the chosen period and must lie within the assignment line.
assignment.assignmentKeyHint: Key of the employee's assignment line (primary / concurrent).

plan.summary: {days, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}} · {hours, number} standard hours

std.byPeriodHint: STD_DAYS / STD_HOURS with the method and value Payroll published for the period.
std.previewHint: Compute for any date range, e.g. before the pay group's first period exists.

unscheduled.title: Unscheduled employees
unscheduled.subtitle: Assignment lines valid on the date without a schedule
unscheduled.pickLegalEntity: Select a legal entity to see the list.

warning.title: Saved with statutory warnings
warning.normal-hours-above-daily-limit: Normal hours above the daily limit
warning.normal-hours-above-weekly-limit: Normal hours above the weekly limit

common.codeHint: Upper-case letters, digits, '-' or '_'; cannot be changed later.
common.statusHint: Cannot be deactivated while in use.
common.pickEmployee: Select an employee to see their schedules.

errors.alternating-rest-day: The weekly rest day must be the same in every week; mark the free day of the other weeks as Off.
errors.break-times-required: A fixed break needs its start and end.
errors.break-outside-shift: The break lies outside the shift.
errors.break-duration-mismatch: The break duration does not match its start and end.
errors.flexible-break-has-times: A flexible break has no start or end.
errors.employment-not-in-period: The employee has no assignment in the period's legal entity during the period.
errors.invalid-anchor: The anchor date must be a Monday.
errors.invalid-cycle: A pattern has 7 or 14 days (N-day rotations are not available yet).
errors.invalid-day-value: The day value lies between 0 and 1.
errors.invalid-days: Give each day of the cycle exactly once.
errors.invalid-night-window: Give both ends of the night window, or neither.
errors.invalid-period: The end date must be after the start date.
errors.invalid-punch-window-after: Invalid punch window after the end (0–720 min).
errors.invalid-punch-window-before: Invalid punch window before the start (0–720 min).
errors.invalid-std-hours: Standard hours exceed the shift's working time.
errors.legal-entity-and-date-required: The legal entity and the date are required.
errors.legal-entity-required: A rule on an org unit also names the unit's legal entity.
errors.outside-assignment-line: The schedule must lie within the assignment line.
errors.pattern-in-use: The pattern is in use; its cycle and days cannot change and it cannot be deactivated.
errors.rule-schedule-not-cancellable: A rule-based schedule cannot be cancelled; change the rule or add a manual schedule.
errors.schedule-assignment-incomplete: The assignment line, pattern and start date are required.
errors.schedule-assignment-overlap: A manual schedule already covers this period; end or cancel it first.
errors.shift-in-use: The shift is used by a pattern; its times cannot change and it cannot be deactivated.
errors.shift-not-allowed: Only a working day has a shift.
errors.shift-times-required: Enter the start and end times.
errors.std-day-method-not-published: Payroll has not published the standard-day method of this period yet.
errors.std-day-value-required: A fixed method needs a positive value.
errors.unknown-assignment-line: The assignment line is not one of this employee's or is not known to T&A yet.
errors.unknown-shift: A working day needs an active shift.
errors.weekly-rest-required: Every week needs at least one weekly rest day.
errors.version-required: The record version is missing; reload and try again.
